protocol.arm: production saveMemoryHandler (dry_run for new saves and overwrites) and editMemoryHandler, read from daemon/dist; BM25 candidate generation as in save_quality
protocol.index_scope: one temporary vault, built through saveMemoryHandler so superseded_by is stamped by the real replaces path; removed afterwards
protocol.corpus: 16 invented correction chains (8 en, 8 de; 4 of them three versions long), 21 living neighbours in the same scopes, 14 fresh saves; no real vault content
protocol.positives: reassert-paraphrase and reassert-verbatim: a new save of the first version's claim; correct = the advisory names a member of that chain
protocol.negatives: fresh saves (unrelated, same topic, near duplicate of a living memory), save_memory(overwrite) and edit_memory(append, undone) of every non-superseded memory
protocol.separate_class: agrees-with-correction: a new save restating the chain head; counted as a false warning in the overall figure and excluded from ordinary_saves
primary: precision and recall of the advisory over the positives
false-warning rate over ordinary saves (issue target: below 2%)
secondary: advice names the current chain head
protocol.seed: none; deterministic corpus order, no random draw
protocol.baseline: descriptive, no post-hoc threshold; the similarity band (DUPLICATE_SIMILARITY_MIN) is not tuned here
protocol.not_covered: the losing side of a resolved #205 conflict (no record of it exists); memories archived with archive_memory; hybrid/dense arms; real-vault population

existing_copy_protocol.isolation: Copy root is a new 0700 bastra-eval643-copy-* directory under physical system temp, with regular independently copied Markdown files only. Output is a new sibling outside vault. Set AppDB and vault-root registry after test-env, before core/daemon imports; never read application settings or open the operator database.
existing_copy_protocol.metrics: Aggregate replay warning frequencies and routing on explicit complete accessible replacement chains; null for empty denominators. No semantic precision/recall or ordinary-save false-warning claim from unlabelled stored text.
existing_copy_protocol.retrieval: Lexical-only BM25 and weighted field Jaccard, no embedding provider. Historical synthetic results below remain separate and unchanged.
